documents.notes: Official Cybersecurity and Privacy Reference Tool (CPRT) export; server file name cprt-AI_100_1_0_0-<timestamp>.json; byte-identical on repeated download. Flat graph: 4 function, 19 category, 72 subcategory elements plus the Playbook itemised as 77 about, 575 suggested_action, 292 documentation, 195 resource and 631 reference elements, 95 sort keys, 1,956 'projection' (parent-child) relationships; no mappings to other frameworks.
